nodes.name: Schedule Trigger - Daily FX Pull
nodes.notes: Fires daily at 06:00 UTC. n8n resolves this time against the instance timezone, not the node, so docker-compose.yml pins GENERIC_TIMEZONE=UTC and TZ=UTC - on any other stand (n8n Cloud included) verify Settings > Workflow > Timezone is UTC before relying on the hour. To change the fire time, edit triggerAtHour/triggerAtMinute on this node and re-export per the Export discipline in root CLAUDE.md. Satisfies TASK R2/R3.

nodes.name: Set - Loader Config
nodes.notes: Defines base_currency as a single editable field so it is not hardcoded into the HTTP Request URL/query. Satisfies TASK R1.

nodes.name: HTTP Request - Fetch Latest Rates
nodes.notes: Calls freecurrencyapi.com /latest with base_currency from Set - Loader Config. Uses the freecurrencyapi credential (httpQueryAuth), imported via scripts/import_credentials.sh under a fixed id (fcaHttpQueryAuth) so this file resolves the same credential on any Docker stand without manual reselection in the n8n UI — see that script for the id's single source of truth. onError=continueErrorOutput routes transport/HTTP failures to the second output instead of aborting the workflow. Satisfies TASK R1, R4. Retries transiently-failed requests (timeout, 5xx, rate limit) up to 3 times with a 2s wait before onError routes to the error branch — satisfies TASK R1/R2 of loader-http-retry.

nodes.name: IF - Response OK
nodes.notes: Partial-data guard: a 200 response with an empty/missing data object must not be treated as success (a transport-level success is not the same as a valid payload). False branch routes to the error log. Satisfies TASK R4.

nodes.name: Code - Rates To Rows
nodes.notes: Transforms the freecurrencyapi { data: { EUR: 0.92, ... } } object into an array of { base_currency, target_currency, rate, fetched_at } rows matching docs/data-table-schema.md. Code node justified here (built-in Set/Split cannot enumerate an arbitrary object's keys into rows with a computed timestamp). Satisfies TASK R2.

nodes.name: IF - Rows Valid
nodes.notes: Structural partial-data guard on the transformed rows: the API response must have yielded at least one row at all. A totally empty/unusable payload never reaches the Data Table write and instead routes to Code - Build Error Record -> Stop and Error, failing the run. Per-field validation of each individual row (correct types, non-NaN rate) happens later, per row, at IF - Row Fields Valid, so one malformed currency no longer blocks the others. Satisfies TASK R4.

nodes.name: Split Out - Rows To Items
nodes.notes: Turns the single-item rows array into one item per currency pair, so IF - Row Fields Valid and the Data Table upsert operate on one currency at a time instead of the whole batch.

nodes.name: IF - Row Fields Valid
nodes.notes: Per-row validation, evaluated once per currency after Split Out - Rows To Items: base_currency, target_currency, a numeric non-NaN rate and fetched_at must all be present. A malformed row (e.g. one bad currency code in an otherwise good response) never reaches Data Table - Upsert Rate Row -- it is routed to Code - Log Skipped Row instead, which logs it without throwing, so every other valid currency in the same run still upserts. Replaces the previous all-or-nothing .every() check that used to fail the whole run over a single bad row. Satisfies TASK R1/R2 of loader-row-level-validation.

nodes.name: Code - Log Skipped Row
nodes.notes: Terminal node for a single invalid row (no outgoing connection): records which currency pair was skipped and why, visible in the execution log, without throwing -- unlike Code - Build Error Record -> Stop and Error, this must NOT fail the run, because other valid rows in the same execution still need to reach Data Table - Upsert Rate Row. Code node justified: per-item field inspection with fallbacks is beyond what a Set node expresses cleanly. Satisfies TASK R2/R3 of loader-row-level-validation.

nodes.name: Data Table - Upsert Rate Row
nodes.notes: Upserts into currency_rates keyed on (base_currency, target_currency) using the node's native upsert operation, satisfying the re-runnable/idempotent convention in root CLAUDE.md. dataTableId uses mode="name" rather than a specific instance's id so this file imports cleanly on any Docker stand where make setup-data-table has created the table, without per-instance patching. Satisfies TASK R3.

nodes.name: Code - Build Error Record
nodes.notes: Single convergence point for all loader failures (HTTP error output, invalid response payload, invalid transformed rows). Emits a structured record - failure_stage, error_message, base_currency, failed_at - so a failed daily run is diagnosable from the execution log without re-running it. Code node justified here because the three inbound branches carry structurally different items, and choosing between them requires conditional inspection that a Set node cannot express (the validation-rules exemption in root CLAUDE.md). Isolated from the Data Table write path so failures never corrupt currency_rates. Satisfies TASK R4.

nodes.name: Stop and Error - Fail Loader Run
nodes.notes: Terminates the error branch by throwing, so the run is marked failed in n8n's executions list. Without this the workflow would report success on a day when no rates were loaded, which is the failure mode this task exists to remove. Has no outgoing connection and never reaches Data Table - Upsert Rate Row, so the isolation guarantee is unchanged. Satisfies TASK R4.

main.node: Stop and Error - Fail Loader Run
